**1. Every "Distinct" verdict in `battery_summary.json` divides a healthy positive numerator by a broken negative ceiling; every instruct "Shared" verdict divides two broken negatives. The four-line evidence chain (matched-subsample recovery, random-projection control, overshoot cosine signature, the instrument's own #1335 documentation with un-engaged mitigations) makes this HIGH confidence.

Both lane headlines in `epm:results` are unsupported.** The pretrained "H2 (user-directed-only)" lookup is void twice over: its exposition-Distinct input is a broken-denominator artifact (numerator +0.409/+0.436 ≈ 75% of the full-n anchors — if anything Shared-leaning), and its rude-Shared input comes from an exploratory cell (10.9% yield, content-collapsed, own-map R² −0.002 — "map existence" cleared only the very wide n=516 null band, a gate mis-calibration at small n).
